notes_for_editor: Thin record: a 2006 sale notice (easternuslookouts) and the tnlandforms survey entry. No build date, staffing, fire history or present-day source found. Searches used: 3 (over the 2-per-tower budget). Brief 'registers' field lists 'GFC US 222'; tnlandforms prints gfc-222, and neither the NHLR nor the FFLOS Georgia list includes this tower. Editor should decide whether GFC numbers belong in 'registers'. Map directories (topoquest, anyplaceamerica) show a 'Hawthorne Trail Lookout Tower' at these coordinates, but I saw them only as search snippets and did not cite them; they do not describe the structure. Fact-check 2026-10-21: tnlandforms is a third-party list that cites GFC for coordinates, so the story no longer calls it the state's survey; the auction notice says removal was required, not who the buyer was, so the story no longer names a buyer; FFLOS is not labelled national, so the story no longer calls it a national register. tnlandforms prints no elevation unit, so 'feet' is inferred.
